Doses used were 300 micrograms busere- lin intranasally in the evenings of days 1 to 21 of the menstrual cycle and 10 mg medroxyprogesterone acetate daily by mouth from day 12 to 21. Both patients were free from porphyric at- tacks during the reported 11 months of treatment.1 Intranasal buserelin has also been used in 1 patient to prevent premenstrual exacerbation of coproporphyria.2 The initial dose of 900 micrograms daily could be tapered to 150 micrograms daily, with only 1 minor attack in 5 years of treatment.
